findings.title: Product search returns all products without user ownership verification

evidence.why: Only filters by search term, no ownership check
Category filter only, no user_id or owner binding

findings.attack_scenario: Authenticated User A sends GET /search.php?q=widget&cat=electronics with another user's product ID in results and receives products they don't own.
findings.impact: Read other customers' product data (names, categories, potentially prices if returned).
findings.recommendation: Add AND user_id = :current_user_id to all product queries, or load products then compare owner and return 404 on mismatch

route_verdicts.reason: Registration endpoint creates new user records; no object identifier to manipulate for accessing another user's existing data
